# <Bounded delivery>

Use inside an existing change record, or as `changes/<change>/record.md` when no owner exists. [Delivery task records](../standards/documentation.md#delivery-task-records) own lifecycle; [bounded change](../workflows/bounded-change.md) decides eligibility. Keep entries short and link sources.

## Current checkpoint

Objective, scope and authorization:
Workflow / stage / owner and paths:
Branch / base revision / delivery target:
Implementation, verification and documentation status:
Required checks, reviewer coverage, results and evidence:
Affected-document dispositions under the closeout gate:
Unresolved findings / changed dependencies / next action:
